name: Taihen da! Imouto ni Ochi○po ga Haechattazo!!!
original_name: 大変だ!妹におち○ぽが生えちゃったぞ!!!
source:
Little sister Shoko sprouts a peen. 
Big brother sees it and just has to play with her. 
Here's how to feel good. 
Shoko will come to love the futanari life......

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE179364.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
小妹妹翔子长出了一颗鸡冠。
哥哥看见了，只好陪她玩。
以下是如何感觉良好。
翔子将会爱上扶他的生活……

[来自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE179364.html]DLsite英文[/url]]
